title: Prediction-Powered Regression via Calibration: Beyond the Supervised Minimax Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.30976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study nonparametric regression with limited labeled data and abundant observations carrying potentially inaccurate pseudo-labels. Our proposed method, weighted prediction-powered regression via calibration (wPPRC), first calibrates pseudo-labels using labeled data, then fits a predictor by weighted regression using observed and calibrated responses. Over H\"older classes, we derive nonasymptotic excess-risk bounds for clipped ReLU estimators and establish a minimax lower bound for the corresponding regression problem. Under suitable conditions, the upper and lower bounds match up to logarithmic factors. Moreover, wPPRC can achieve a worst-case risk of smaller order than the minimax risks under four baseline observation structures on the same joint distribution class, demonstrating the value of additional pseudo-labels. translated_title: 基于校准的预测驱动回归：超越有监督极小极大基准
translated_abstract: 我们研究标注数据有限、而携带可能不准确伪标签的观测数据大量存在情形下的非参数回归问题。我们提出的方法——基于校准的加权预测驱动回归，首先利用标注数据对伪标签进行校准，然后使用观测响应和校准后的响应通过加权回归来拟合预测器。在 Hölder 类上，我们为截断 ReLU 估计量推导了非渐近超额风险上界，并为相应的回归问题建立了极小极大下界。在适当条件下，上界与下界在对数因子范围内匹配。此外，在同一联合分布类上，wPPRC 能够取得比四种基线观测结构下的极小极大风险更低阶的最坏情形风险，从而展示了额外伪标签的价值。我们还构造了一个验证选择估计量，利用独立的带标注验证样本来进行选择。
tldr: 该论文提出基于校准的加权预测驱动回归方法 wPPRC，通过用标注数据校准伪标签并进行加权回归，在理论上证明其最坏情形风险可以超越有监督极小极大基准，从而体现大量伪标签带来的额外价值。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes wPPRC, a weighted prediction-powered regression method that calibrates pseudo-labels with labeled data before weighted regression, and theoretically shows its worst-case risk can go beyond the supervised minimax benchmark, demonstrating the added value of abundant pseudo-labels.
